title: Ant Ling introduces Ling-3.2-flash: 560B/25B native multimodal MoE with 1M context [N]
summary: Ant Ling has released Ling-3.2-flash, a native multimodal MoE with 560B total parameters, 25B activated parameters and a maximum 1M-token context window. The official documentation specifies text, image and video inputs. The release evaluation reports: MathVision(w/CI): 96.80 Hum
